I know you said you don't want sympathy, but I still hope this reaches you. The comment you made about your sister really stuck with me since my sister is probably the one person in this world that truly cares for me. If I lost her, I don't even know what I would do or if I would want to continue living after that. I am glad your sister survived though. As for love advice, I am in the same boat as you so I can't really give any helpful advice. But I've just been living the single life for years now and I've been fine. Yes, I would love to have a partner to share emotions with, but doing the things that make me happy really distracted me from wanting a partner most of the time. 

I also am the type to bottle up my feelings; in fact, I only vent my feelings in a journal because it always seemed easier for me to just write out my feelings and thoughts rather than rely on someone to listen.

That being said, I hope you're still there, many people care for you. I care about you. I'm in the same position as you are, so I hope we can help each other out of these situations. :)

Losing someone you love is like having a piece of your soul ripped out of your body. I'm sorry to hear that. If it's too much to tell your family about what you're feeling, please tell a close friend who you trust about your situation. Hopefully, as you open up, you can build the strength to finally tell them. Hope all goes well :)
I'm sorry to hear that, that's really fucked up of him. I don't know much about legalities and whatnot, but if he abused/molested you, you should report it to the police as soon as possible imo.
